card.summary: 1 TB free from signup ('Get 1TB Free Cloud Storage From Datum'), S3-compatible endpoint

free_tier.stated: 1 TB free from signup ('Get 1TB Free Cloud Storage From Datum'), S3-compatible endpoint

egress.terms: Not published on the getstarted page; sold as 'decentralized cloud storage' with S3 API compatibility (unverified per-GB)

record.tooling: S3 API only ('designed to be compatible with the Amazon S3 API format'); tested clients Arq Backup, Duplicati/Duplicity/Duplicacy untested
record.chaining: 1 TB x N identities, but each identity needs a phone-verified Datum ID, so identity cost is the multiplier
record.limits_note: 1 TB/account; requires the Datum ID mobile app on iOS/Android as the identity provider. There is no web-only path.
record.reliability_note: app-gated identity makes account automation awkward; the product markets itself as early-stage ('not all [S3 clients] have been tested')

evidence.proved: 'Datum Storage accounts are attached to a Datum Identity... creating a Datum Identity will require verification of your email address and phone number'; 'designed to be compatible with the Amazon S3 API format'
'Datum ID on the App Store / Google Play' (no web signup path)
